title: Journey stepper
description: Directly under the hero in transactional journeys. Labels max 4 words.
usage: Shows where the user is in a 3-step journey. Icons from the Abbott icon set. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Yellow circle + icon flattened into one transparent PNG

notes: Figma's stepper is three yellow icon circles separated by › chevrons (no numbered dots or connector lines), so it is built as 30% / 5% table cells; the circles are images, so they stay round in Outlook.
Does not stack on mobile — labels wrap instead.
Icons are decorative (alt=""); the labels carry the meaning.
Yellow circles are hard-coded #FFD100 in Figma and stay yellow in dark mode.
